package.description: Event-sourced orders with Bounda: every change is an event in a Durable Object's SQLite, projected into a read model before the request answers.

BOUNDA_MASTER_KEY.description: The master key every person's key is wrapped under, so a copy of the database opens none of their data without it: 32 random bytes in base64. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and keep it; a new one cannot open what the old one wrapped. [Where the keys live](https://docs.bounda.dev/guides/personal-data/#where-the-keys-live)
